description: lsp2 conformance vectors. Keys are derived as SHA-256(label) used as Ed25519 seed. 'now' is the verification time (NumericDate). Implementations MUST verify every jws entry with the listed key/expectations and MUST reject every negative entry. Signers are not required to reproduce payload bytes exactly, but Ed25519 over signing_input with the given key MUST yield signature_b64url (Ed25519 is deterministic).

negative.name: wrong_key
negative.must_reject_because: signed by device key, not gateway key

negative.name: proof_as_access_token
negative.must_reject_because: typ lsp2-proof+jwt is not at+jwt (explicit typing)

negative.name: task_id_mismatch
negative.must_reject_because: payload task_id differs from envelope task_id

negative.name: proof_wrong_ath
negative.must_reject_because: ath does not match the presented access token

negative.name: proof_wrong_aud
negative.must_reject_because: proof minted for hello replayed as session.token

valid_frames.name: unknown type (receivers ignore or answer error, never crash)

invalid_frames.name: task_run_with_data
invalid_frames.must_reject_because: task.run payload must only travel inside jws

invalid_frames.name: delta_text_and_e2ee
invalid_frames.must_reject_because: a sealed delta carries no cleartext text/tool_calls

negative.name: jwe_tampered_header
negative.must_reject_because: protected header is the GCM AAD

negative.name: chunk_wrong_seq
negative.must_reject_because: seq is bound into nonce and AAD (reordering)

negative.name: chunk_wrong_type
negative.must_reject_because: frame type is bound into AAD

negative.name: chunk_wrong_rid
negative.must_reject_because: request id is bound into AAD (cross-request splicing)

negative.name: key_statement_wrong_pin
negative.must_reject_because: device identity key does not match the thumbprint pinned at pairing

negative.name: key_statement_signed_by_other_key
negative.must_reject_because: signature must verify with the pinned device key
